subject: Marine Works - Port of Quebec - Pier 24
text:
Marine Works - Port of Quebec - Pier 24
Wharf construction operations taking place daily 24 hours a day beginning 03 Aug 2026.
Minimum wake and wide berth requested. Keep clear 50 metres from dock edge.
For any questions or additional information contact the Port of Quebec Harbour Master's Office on VHF channel 77 or 418-648-3556.
